how: Each payload is what the tool actually returned on 2026-11-14, taken from the inner `data` of a success envelope or from the whole result when the call errored -- which is the value `tu test` validates a return_schema against. Recorded verbatim except where a row's `note` says otherwise. A reading like this is a LOWER BOUND on the shapes a live API can produce, never the complete set; it is enough to catch a declaration that contradicts a shape that was seen.
invariant: Every recorded payload validates against its tool's declared return_schema, and when that schema is a oneOf, EXACTLY ONE branch matches it. Two branches matching means the union is not discriminated and `oneOf` rejects a payload both halves accept; zero means the declaration contradicts the data.

summaryMarkdown.html: The FDA-approved drug label for bosutinib (BOSULIF) notes that it is intended for adult and pediatric patients with chronic phase Philadelphia chromosome-positive (Ph+) chronic myelogenous leukemia (CML) and for adult patients with accelerated or blast phase Ph+ CML with resistance or intolerance to prior therapy.

textMarkdown.html:
Bosutinib is a tyrosine kinase inhibitor whose substrates include the Bcr-Abl kinase that promotes chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) and is encoded by the Philadelphia chromosome.

Excerpts from the bosutinib (BOSULIF) drug label:

BOSULIF is a kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of

  • adult and pediatric patients 1 year of age and older with chronic phase Ph+ chronic myelogenous leukemia (CML), newly-diagnosed or resistant or intolerant to prior therapy.
  • adult patients with accelerated, or blast phase Ph+ CML with resistance or intolerance to prior therapy.

Bosutinib is a TKI. Bosutinib inhibits the BCR-ABL kinase that promotes CML; it is also an inhibitor of Src-family kinases including Src, Lyn, and Hck. Bosutinib inhibited 16 of 18 imatinib-resistant forms of BCR-ABL kinase expressed in murine myeloid cell lines. Bosutinib did not inhibit the T315I and V299L mutant cells.

For the complete drug label text with sections containing pharmacogenetic information highlighted, see the bosutinib drug label.
